scripts.dev:electron: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64
